overview.description: The MicroSectors FANG+ ETN (FNGS) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the NYSE FANG+ index. The fund tracks an equally-weighted index of US-listed technology and consumer discretionary companies, selected by a committee. FNGS was launched on Nov 15, 2019 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
